limitations: 72 discovered URL(s) were never fetched (permission, acquisition failure, or budget constraints; out of 78 discovered); findings reflect only the 6 page(s) actually crawled, not the whole site. The sample reached 2 of 26 site sections (first path segment).

Headless browser rendering was not available in this environment; rendering-gap findings are based on a static-content heuristic only and are reported as suspected/insufficient_evidence rather than confirmed.
No external search provider was configured; claim corroboration and off-site footprint assessment were not checked this run (not the same as "nothing found").
17 linked PDF(s) were not fetched (robots rules, a cross-origin redirect, the per-audit cap of 3, or remaining budget; see coverage.non_text_media.pdf_outcomes); their contents were not assessed.

Review and directory platforms (Trustpilot, G2, Google Business Profile and others) were not searched for the brand: they block automated clients, no search provider was configured, and the agent stage (AG-06) was not supplied. Only profiles linked from the site were considered.
Core Web Vitals (LCP, CLS, INP) were not measured: the audit runs no browser and no PAGESPEED_API_KEY is configured. Web-vitals findings are estimates from markup patterns, not measurements.
Colour contrast and tap-target size were judged only where inline styles set them; colours and sizes from stylesheets need a browser to compute and were not assessed.
133 same-origin content image(s) were not measured for file size (per-audit cap of 4 or remaining budget); cross-origin images are never requested, so their weight is unassessed.
sitemap.xml could not be checked (status: 'inaccessible'); crawl coverage may be incomplete relative to a site that publishes one.

Agent check AG-01 (About-page concreteness) was not assessed: The selected opening is homepage program teaser text at an empty About fragment; its representativeness as the organization About opening was not established. No missing-identity defect is inferred.
Agent check AG-02 (Independent mentions) was not assessed: No independent-source search was performed in this run.
Agent check AG-03 (Independent contradiction) was not assessed: No acquired claim was compared with inspected independent sources.
Agent check AG-04 (Facts drawn inside images) was not assessed: No full packet-listed image was viewed.
Agent check AG-05 (Namesake ambiguity) was not assessed: No namesake search or distinguishing-source inspection was performed.
Agent check AG-06 (Review and profile opportunity) was not assessed: No applicable platform-specific search was performed.

confidence.method: min(sample_representativeness, observation_completeness, execution_penalty), where sample_representativeness = max(crawl_completeness, min(section_coverage, sample_size)), capped at 0.9 unless discovery_reliable is true, and crawl_completeness = pages_analyzed / pages_discovered; observation_completeness = (pages read in full + half of pages read in part) / (pages analyzed + challenged, waiting-room, timed-out and failed fetches). A weak link caps the score rather than being averaged out. identity_confidence is reported beside the score, not in it: it gates only the checks that depend on the brand's identity
confidence.interpretation: A heuristic rating of how far the report speaks for the whole site, not a calibrated probability. Each finding states its own confidence.

reasons.sample_representativeness: The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 5 of 78 discovered page(s) and reached 2 of 26 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched).
reasons.observation_completeness: Not every page was read in full: 1 fetch(es) returned no readable content (a challenge, waiting room, timeout or failure).
reasons.identity_confidence: No Organization markup was found; the brand name was read from the site's own metadata (site name, title suffix or copyright line), which is less certain. Adding Organization markup confirms it.

confidence.explanation: Confidence is low (0.08). The weakest of its parts sets the score, here the page sample. The page sample is small or one-sided: the crawl analyzed 5 of 78 discovered page(s) and reached 2 of 26 site section(s); the crawl is known to have missed URLs (a crawl or sitemap read limit, or URLs left unfetched). Brand identity (reported separately, not part of the score): No Organization markup was found; the brand name was read from the site's own metadata (site name, title suffix or copyright line), which is less certain. Adding Organization markup confirms it. The score rates how far the report speaks for the whole site; each finding has its own confidence and status, and a problem seen on a page is still real on that page.
